:::{.callout-learning}
After completing this session, you will be able to:

- Install or update R, RStudio, and Quarto on your computer
- Check whether Git is installed, and install it if it is not
- Install the R packages used in the course
- Create a GitHub account
- Troubleshoot common problems with installing the software
:::

## Overview

This guide walks through installing the software used in the course: R, RStudio, Quarto, Git, and the required R packages, plus creating a GitHub account.  Follow the steps for your operating system (macOS or Windows).  Troubleshooting tips are at the end.
